How a persona chooses

A persona decides what a shopper picks; the shop never sees it. Nobody reads a listing to the end and takes the optimum: Persona.Choose scans the first {{.ScanDepth}} positions, considers what scores at least {{pct .GoodEnough}} of its favourite there, and picks one, position n weighted 1/n, seeded so the traffic is reproducible. If nothing near the top is good enough, it scrolls on to its favourite. So a shopper does not always open the first product, nor, from a listing not yet ranked for it, its best match. The shoppers report shows the picks it makes.

Rankings

The whole catalog, both departments, ordered by each persona's score: its taste against each product's attractor, in the product's own category's weights. The front of each row should look like the persona, the back like its opposite.
